name: agents-context-router
description: Route coding agents to only the repository context each task needs.

interface.shortDescription: Split a bloated AGENTS.md into a small kernel and task-routed wiki topics
interface.longDescription: Turn an oversized AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md into a small always-loaded kernel plus wiki topics that a dependency-free script loads on demand, with byte budgets and orphan checks so the docs cannot drift.
defaultPrompt: Our AGENTS.md is too big. Split it into a small kernel and task-specific wiki topics.
